section.p: The Client has engaged to provide maintenance services for the software, or systems specified in this Contract. has agreed to provide such maintenance services under the terms and conditions set forth herein, and troubleshooting and bug fixing for issues. div.p: NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein, the Parties agree as follows:

section.p: 1.1.This Contract is executed between and on the date mentioned as the Effective date

div.p: 1.2.The details of the solution are specified in Annexure-A-1.

section.p: 2.1.General:

2.1.1. agrees to provide Client with Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services, including but not limited to maintenance, support, consulting, configuration and customization services related to products mentioned in Annexure – A-1.

div.p: 2.1.2.Any developments, new module setup & configurations and customizations done after the effective date, shall not be covered under this Agreement. The Parties shall mutually agree on scope and commercial terms separate of this Agreement in such instances.

section.p: 2.2.Scope of AMC Services (Currently capped at remote man-hours annually):
2.2.1.Support Services:
2.2.1.1.Provide ongoing support, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and system monitoring.

div.p: 2.2.1.2.Offer assistance with configuration changes, minor customizations, and system updates as required.
2.2.1.3.Support services will be available between Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (GMT +4), excluding public holidays as per the UAE public holiday calendar.

section.p: 2.2.2.Maintenance Services:
2.2.2.1.Installation of updates, patches, and hotfixes as released by products mentioned in Annexure – A-1
2.2.3.Incident Management:

2.2.3.1.Categorization of incidents into different priority levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low) based on impact and urgency. Defined response and resolution times (business hours) for each priority level:
2.2.3.1.1.Critical: Response within 1 hour, resolution within 4 hours.

div.p: 2.2.3.1.2.High: Response within 2 hours, resolution within 8 hours.
2.2.3.1.3.Medium: Response within 4 hours, resolution within 48 hours.
2.2.3.1.4.Low: Response within 8 hours, resolution within 96 hours.

section.p: 2.2.4.Exclusions:
2.2.4.1.Major system upgrades or new version implementations of products mentioned in Annexure – A-1.

div.p: 2.2.4.2.Third-party software or hardware support, unless specifically covered under the AMC.

section.p: 3.1.This Contract shall commence on and continue for a period of one (1) year, unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Contract.

div.p: 3.2.This Contract may be renewed upon mutual written agreement of the Parties.
3.3.The contract will automatically renew for successive one-year periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal, or change, at least 30 days prior to the end of the current term.

section.p: 4.1.AMC Fee:
4.1.1.The AMC fee for the support and maintenance will be per annum.

div.p: 4.1.2.The fee covers all services specified in the scope of AMC services.

section.p: 4.2.Payment Terms:

4.2.1.The AMC fee is payable in two equal instalments. The first instalment shall be on or before the commencement of the contract period and the second instalment on or before 6 months post the commencement contract period.

div.p: 4.2.2.Payments are due within net 10 days of the invoice date.

section.p: 9.1.Each Party (“Receiving Party”) agrees to treat as confidential all information, whether written, electronic, or oral, disclosed by the other party (“Disclosing Party”) that is designated as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given the nature of the information or the circumstances of disclosure (the “Confidential Information”).
9.2.The Receiving Party agrees:
9.2.1.not to use Confidential Information for any purpose other than the performance of its obligations or exercise of its rights under this Contract.

div.p: 9.2.2.not to disclose the Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party, except as expressly permitted in Clause 9.3.

9.2.3.to limit access to the Confidential Information to those employees, agents, or subcontractors who need access for purposes consistent with this Contract and who are bound by obligations of confidentiality no less restrictive than those contained herein; and

9.2.4.to use the same degree of care in protecting the Confidential Information as it uses to protect its own confidential and proprietary information, but in no event less than a reasonable standard of care.

section.p: 9.3.The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information without the Disclosing Party’s prior written consent:

9.3.1.to the extent required by applicable law, regulation, or court order, provided that the Receiving Party gives the Disclosing Party prompt written notice (to the extent legally permissible) and reasonable assistance in seeking a protective order or other appropriate remedy; or

div.p: 9.3.2.to its legal, financial, or professional advisors, provided such advisors are bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained in this clause.

section.p: 9.4.The obligations under this Clause 9 shall not apply to information that:
9.4.1.is or becomes publicly available without breach of this Contract by the Receiving Party;

div.p: 9.4.2.was lawfully in the Receiving Party’s possession before receiving receipt from the Disclosing Party;
9.4.3.is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information; or
9.4.4.is lawfully disclosed to the Receiving Party by a third party without restriction on disclosure.

9.4.5.Upon termination or expiration of this Contract, or upon the Disclosing Party’s written request, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or securely destroy all Confidential Information, including any copies, and certify such return or destruction to the Disclosing Party, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law.

9.5.The obligations of confidentiality under this Clause 9 shall survive the termination or expiration of this Contract for a period of five (5) years, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Parties or as required by applicable law.

9.6.Both Parties acknowledge that unauthorized disclosure or use of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm to the Disclosing Party, and monetary damages may not be an adequate remedy. Accordingly, the Disclosing Party shall have the right to seek injunctive relief or other equitable remedies to enforce this Clause 9 in addition to any other rights or remedies available at law or in equity.

11.1.Neither party (“Affected Party”) shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations under this Contract (except for payment obligations) if and to the extent such failure or delay is caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to acts of God, natural disasters (such as earthquakes, floods, or hurricanes), acts of government or regulatory authorities (including changes in laws, regulations, or government orders), war, terrorism, civil unrest, embargoes, labor strikes or disputes (excluding strikes or disputes involving the Affected Party’s own employees), pandemics, epidemics, interruptions or failure of utilities, transportation, or communication services (each a "Force Majeure Event").

div.p: 11.2.The Affected Party shall: promptly notify the other Party in writing of the Force Majeure Event, providing reasonable details about the nature and expected duration of the event; use all reasonable efforts to mitigate the effects of the Force Majeure Event and resume performance as soon as practicable; and keep the other Party reasonably informed of the progress in mitigating the Force Majeure Event.

11.3.If the Force Majeure Event continues for a period exceeding thirty (30) consecutive days, either Party may terminate this Contract by providing written notice to the other Party, without liability, except for any rights or obligations accrued prior to the occurrence of the Force Majeure Event.

11.4.Force Majeure shall not excuse or delay performance of any obligation that arose prior to the occurrence of the Force Majeure Event, nor shall it apply if the Force Majeure Event could have been avoided or mitigated by the Affected Party through the exercise of reasonable diligence.

This Clause does not limit either Party’s rights under other provisions of this Contract, including any right to suspend performance or terminate the Contract due to non-performance unrelated to a Force Majeure Event.
